choices.why: The light ash desk with slim tapered legs is the most purely Nordic option, suits the light floor, and at 118 cm fits well beside the window.
This padded white swivel chair is comfortable and soft-looking, picks up the white walls, and its dark base echoes the black window frame.
The tall white-stained wood bookcase is 90 cm wide, holds plenty of books, blends into the right-hand white wall, and has a simple Scandinavian look.
This classic Nordic wingback has light wood legs and is very comfortable for reading, and its soft green adds a natural touch that goes with the trees outside.
The grey adjustable reading lamp aims its light at the book, takes up little space beside the armchair, and its grey matches the chair base.

answer.why: Light wood, white, and soft touches of grey and green build a calm Nordic corner that works with the wood floor and white walls. Small dark details tie in with the black frame of the window.
